title: Backend Engineering Journey
description: Rebuild the fundamentals. Think before you code.
rules: Before implementation, write requirements, rules, data, algorithm, responsibilities, failure cases, and expected acceptance-test outcomes.
Ask AI to review your design or give one hint before asking for implementation.
Work independently for 25 minutes before asking AI for implementation help.
After finishing a topic, explain it without looking at code or notes.
Mastery means explaining why each class and method exists, why the data is modeled this way, and why the algorithm works.
